prompt: Surreal but photorealistic aerial drone photograph at sunset. On a vast stone plaza, two impossible giant doors stand next to each other. On the left: Cheomseongdae, the ancient bottle-shaped stone observatory of Gyeongju, scaled up to skyscraper size, with a tall wooden door open at its base spilling warm golden light, autumn ginkgo trees around it. On the right: a giant doorway shaped like an arch of Gwangan Bridge in Busan, the suspension bridge glowing with rainbow LED lights, the doorway filled with bright turquoise sea light and splashing waves. Hundreds of tiny ordinary people in jeans and t-shirts walk from the bottom of the frame toward the doors and divide into two lines, half going into the stone observatory door, half going into the bridge sea door. Wide composition, both doors fully visible, dramatic orange and pink sky.

Photorealistic high aerial drone shot looking down at a wide sandy plaza at golden hour. Two colossal gateways stand side by side like giant doors. On the left: a gigantic Cheomseongdae stone observatory from Gyeongju, its round stone body with a square window glowing warm golden, a huge open door at its base. On the right: a gigantic gate formed by the twin towers and cables of Gwangan Bridge in Busan, lit in vivid blue and purple lights, with ocean water shimmering inside the doorway. A huge crowd of hundreds of ordinary modern people in casual clothes walks away from the camera, splitting into two streams, one entering each gate. Long shadows, warm gold versus cool ocean blue, strong color contrast.
